links.outcome: Targeted retrieval versus recent-notes truncation when records exceed context, on extraction and timeline tasks
links.effect: For Imaging Procedures, RAG exceeded long-context performance by 0.17-9.83 F1 using <8K tokens; Antibiotic Timelines matched long-context (-3.26 to +3.24 Jaccard); Diagnosis Generation static.
links.quote: For Imaging Procedures, RAG strongly outperformed recent-note inputs and exceeded long-context performance (by 0.17-9.83 F1 across all models) using fewer than 8K tokens.

unlisted_practices: Using retrieval-augmented generation instead of long-context prompting for token efficiency in EHR reasoning
